location_exception_reason: Aircraft hangars are engineered-to-order industrial structures sold nationally by capability and design, not regional origin; location in title adds no buyer decision value beyond seller geography already exposed by IndiaMART's business-type and location filters.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Fabricator, Contractor) describe who is selling, not what is being sold; the product is the hangar structure itself, independent of seller classification, which IndiaMART already exposes as a buyer-facing filter.
